steps.title: Tank north, party south
steps.rule: Stack just inside waymark 3, behind the boss, and stay out of its front half for the Double Sobat on the main tank.

MainTank.rule: Tank Lindwurm from the north, halfway to waymark 1, facing it away from the party. Take the first kick of Double Sobat with mitigation.

steps.title: Tanks wait south of the second kick
steps.cue: The first Double Sobat kick lands
steps.rule: Stay stacked behind the boss on waymark 3. The second kick hits the whole north half again.

MainTank.rule: Sprint south-west, just past the centre line, out of the second kick that follows the first.

OffTank.rule: Wait just south-east of the centre, out of the second kick.

steps.title: Tanks take the Finisher north
steps.cue: The first Double Sobat kick lands
steps.rule: Stay stacked behind the boss on waymark 3: Esoteric Finisher drops a circle on each tank.

MainTank.rule: As soon as the second kick lands, sprint north-west and take your Finisher circle away from the party.

OffTank.rule: As soon as the second kick lands, sprint north-east and take your Finisher circle away from the party.

steps.title: Back to tank north, party south
steps.rule: Stack again just inside waymark 3, behind the boss.

MainTank.rule: Return to the north spot halfway to waymark 1 and keep the boss facing north.
